name: postal-snap
description: A calm, accessible desktop email client.

scripts.tauri:build: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && node scripts/tauri-build.js --require-tauri-signing
scripts.lint: npm run lint:app && npm run lint:test && npm run lint:scripts
scripts.lint:scripts: eslint scripts playwright.config.ts vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts eslint.config.js --max-warnings 0
scripts.lint:fix: eslint src scripts e2e playwright.config.ts vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts eslint.config.js --fix
scripts.audit: npm run audit:npm && npm run audit:cargo
scripts.licenses: npm run licenses:npm && npm run licenses:cargo
scripts.rust:target:win: npm run rust:target:win:x64 && npm run rust:target:win:arm64
scripts.rust:target:mac: npm run rust:target:mac:x64 && npm run rust:target:mac:arm64
scripts.rust:target:linux: npm run rust:target:linux:x64 && npm run rust:target:linux:arm64
scripts.workspace:bootstrap: npm run rust:update && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run sync-version && npm run icons:normalize
scripts.workspace:prepare: npm run workspace:bootstrap && npm run licenses && npm run test:all
scripts.build:win:prepared: npm run build:win:x64:prepared && npm run build:win:arm64:prepared
scripts.build:win:x64: npm run rust:targets:win && npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run build:win:x64:prepared
scripts.build:win:arm64: npm run rust:targets:win && npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run build:win:arm64:prepared
scripts.build:win: npm run build:win:x64 && npm run build:win:arm64
scripts.build:mac:universal: npm run rust:targets:mac && npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run icons:normalize && npm run build:mac:universal:prepared
scripts.build:mas: npm run rust:targets:mac && npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run build:mas:prepared
scripts.build:linux:prepared: npm run build:linux:x64:prepared && npm run build:linux:arm64:prepared
scripts.build:linux:x64: npm run rust:target:linux:x64 && npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run build:linux:x64:prepared
scripts.build:linux:arm64: npm run rust:target:linux:arm64 && npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run build:linux:arm64:prepared
scripts.build:msstore:win:x64: npm run rust:target:win:x64 && npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && dotenv -e .env -- node scripts/tauri-build.js --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --no-bundle --features msstore --config src-tauri/tauri.msstore.conf.json -- --no-default-features
scripts.build:msstore:win:arm64: npm run rust:target:win:arm64 && npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && dotenv -e .env -- node scripts/tauri-build.js --target aarch64-pc-windows-msvc --no-bundle --features msstore --config src-tauri/tauri.msstore.conf.json -- --no-default-features
scripts.build:msstore:win: npm run build:msstore:win:x64 && npm run build:msstore:win:arm64
scripts.build:msstore: npm run build:msstore:win && dotenv -e .env -- node scripts/msstore-pack.js
scripts.build:msstore:x64: npm run build:msstore:win:x64 && dotenv -e .env -- node scripts/msstore-pack.js x64
scripts.build:msstore:arm64: npm run build:msstore:win:arm64 && dotenv -e .env -- node scripts/msstore-pack.js arm64
scripts.release:prepare: npm run workspace:prepare && npm run dist:clean-release-artifacts && npm run release:session:start
scripts.release:win:continue: npm run release:session:verify && npm run release:draft && npm run rust:targets:win && npm run build:win:prepared && npm run release:sign:gpg && npm run release:finalize && npm run release:verify:local && npm run release:verify-draft
scripts.release:win:resume: npm run prerelease:prepare && npm run release:win:continue
scripts.release:win: npm run prerelease:prepare && npm run release:prepare && npm run release:win:continue
scripts.release:mac:continue: npm run release:session:verify && npm run release:wait-draft && npm run rust:targets:mac && npm run build:mac:universal:prepared && npm run build:mac:zip && npm run release:sign:gpg && npm run release:finalize && npm run release:verify:local && npm run release:verify-draft
scripts.release:mac:resume: npm run prerelease:prepare && npm run release:mac:continue
scripts.release:mac: npm run prerelease:prepare && npm run release:prepare && npm run release:mac:continue
scripts.release:mas:continue: npm run release:session:verify && npm run release:wait-draft && npm run build:mas:prepared
scripts.release:mas:resume: npm run prerelease:prepare && npm run release:mas:continue
scripts.release:mas: npm run prerelease:prepare && npm run release:prepare && npm run release:mas:continue
scripts.release:mas:upload: npm run release:mas:continue && npm run build:mas:upload
scripts.release:mac:ssh: npm run mac:ssh:keychain && npm run release:mac
scripts.release:mac:ssh:resume: npm run mac:ssh:keychain && npm run release:mac:resume
scripts.release:linux:x64:continue: npm run release:session:verify && npm run release:wait-draft && npm run build:linux:x64 && npm run flatpak:clean && npm run flatpak:bundle && npm run release:sign:gpg && npm run release:finalize && npm run release:verify:local && npm run release:verify-draft
scripts.release:linux:arm64:continue: npm run release:session:verify && npm run release:wait-draft && npm run build:linux:arm64 && npm run flatpak:clean && npm run flatpak:bundle:arm64 && npm run release:sign:gpg && npm run release:finalize && npm run release:verify:local && npm run release:verify-draft
scripts.release:linux:x64:resume: npm run prerelease:prepare && npm run release:linux:x64:continue
scripts.release:linux:arm64:resume: npm run prerelease:prepare && npm run release:linux:arm64:continue
scripts.release:linux:x64: npm run prerelease:prepare && npm run release:prepare && npm run release:linux:x64:continue
scripts.release:linux:arm64: npm run prerelease:prepare && npm run release:prepare && npm run release:linux:arm64:continue
scripts.b: git fetch origin && git reset --hard && git clean -fd && git switch -C beta origin/beta && git reset --hard origin/beta && git clean -fd && npm run vi
scripts.r: git fetch origin && git reset --hard && git clean -fd && git switch -C main origin/main && git reset --hard origin/main && git clean -fd && npm run vi && npm run gitprune:force
